confirmation.rule: When the first-pass deck completeness is within [trigger_min_percent, trigger_max_percent], run extra_passes more independent checker passes and take, per question, the median value of all passes. A null bound is disabled.

proof.rule: A question marked requires_proof cannot be 'found' from the deck alone. The checker must cite at least one claim whose status is proven (annex) or confirmed (web); otherwise the code caps the value at 'partial'. A question citing a claim left as 'to_probe' after review is lowered by one step.

annex_gate.rule: Fixed list, per stage and business model: the base list below is written for SaaS, the model block adjusts it with its documents verb, the deck never does. Every document must be present, readable, and cover at least min_months, or hold at least min_count items, when one is given. A missing or too short document stops the reading and produces the request email, document by document. There is no coverage threshold at series C: the list is the gate. Claims left uncovered after matching are listed in the report, they never stop the reading.

name.en: Monthly P&L by product and by geography over 48 months
name.fr: P&L mensuel par produit et par géographie sur 48 mois

requirement.en: Revenue and cost of revenue by product and by geography, operating expenses by function (sales and marketing, R&D, G&A), net burn, month by month.
requirement.fr: Revenus et coût des ventes par produit et par géographie, charges par fonction (ventes et marketing, R&D, frais généraux), burn net, mois par mois.

name.en: Audited annual accounts with the auditor's opinion, last three fiscal years
name.fr: Comptes annuels audités avec l'opinion de l'auditeur, trois derniers exercices

requirement.en: Balance sheet, income statement, cash flow statement and the auditor's report with its opinion, for each of the last three fiscal years.
requirement.fr: Bilan, compte de résultat, tableau des flux de trésorerie et rapport de l'auditeur avec son opinion, pour chacun des trois derniers exercices.

name.en: Cohorts by segment and by acquisition year over 36 months or more
name.fr: Cohortes par segment et par année d'acquisition sur 36 mois et plus

requirement.en: Revenue and logo retention by acquisition cohort, split by segment and by acquisition year.
requirement.fr: Rétention du revenu et des logos par cohorte d'acquisition, ventilée par segment et par année d'acquisition.

name.en: CRM export with weighted pipeline, owner, and win/loss with competitor
name.fr: Export CRM avec pipeline pondéré, propriétaire, et win/loss avec le concurrent

requirement.en: Every deal with stage, probability, amount, owner, segment, product, geography, first contact and signature dates; lost deals with the reason and the competitor.
requirement.fr: Chaque affaire avec son étape, sa probabilité, son montant, son propriétaire, son segment, son produit, sa géographie, ses dates de premier contact et de signature ; les affaires perdues avec la raison et le concurrent.

name.en: Sales roster with quota attainment over 24 months
name.fr: Effectif commercial avec l'atteinte des quotas sur 24 mois

requirement.en: Each rep with start date, quota, attainment by quarter, and departures.
requirement.fr: Chaque commercial avec sa date d'entrée, son quota, son atteinte par trimestre, et les départs.

name.en: Billing export with list price, net price and discount over 24 months
name.fr: Export de facturation avec prix liste, prix net et remise sur 24 mois

requirement.en: Every contract with its list price, net price and discount, month by month.
requirement.fr: Chaque contrat avec son prix liste, son prix net et sa remise, mois par mois.

name.en: Cap table with the terms of every round and any debt agreement
name.fr: Table de capitalisation avec les termes de chaque tour et tout contrat de dette

requirement.en: Every holder with its share and the option pool; for every round the liquidation preference, participation, ratchets and secondary sales; every debt agreement with its terms.
requirement.fr: Chaque détenteur avec sa part et le pool d'options ; pour chaque tour la préférence de liquidation, la participation, les ratchets et les cessions secondaires ; chaque contrat de dette avec ses termes.

name.en: Three-year financial model with a zero-burn scenario
name.fr: Modèle financier sur 3 ans avec un scénario à burn zéro

requirement.en: Revenue by product and geography, expenses by function, cash, hires, month by month over 36 months, the breakeven month if planned, and a scenario with spending frozen at the level the cash on hand allows.
requirement.fr: Revenus par produit et par géographie, charges par fonction, trésorerie, recrutements, mois par mois sur 36 mois, le mois du point mort s'il est prévu, et un scénario où les dépenses sont gelées au niveau que permet la trésorerie disponible.

name.en: Signed contracts of the top 20 customers

requirement.en: The signed contract of each of the twenty largest customers by ARR.
requirement.fr: Le contrat signé de chacun des vingt premiers clients par ARR.

name.en: Board decks or minutes with budget vs actual, last eight quarters
name.fr: Supports ou comptes rendus de board avec budget contre réalisé, huit derniers trimestres

requirement.en: The board deck or the minutes of each of the last eight quarters, with the budget or plan of the quarter next to the actual.
requirement.fr: Le support de board ou le compte rendu de chacun des huit derniers trimestres, avec le budget ou le plan du trimestre à côté du réalisé.

name.en: Org chart and headcount history over 36 months
name.fr: Organigramme et historique des effectifs sur 36 mois

requirement.en: Headcount by function month by month, start and end dates, and the executive team with start dates.
requirement.fr: Effectifs par fonction mois par mois, dates d'entrée et de sortie, et l'équipe de direction avec ses dates d'entrée.

gaps.rule: A gap between a deck figure and the figure found in an annex or on the web is classified by code. Ratio = |deck - found| / max(|found|, 1). minor: ratio <= minor_max_ratio, noted, no penalty. to_probe: ratio <= probe_max_ratio, becomes a question for the call. blatant: above, or the fact does not exist; goes to the reviewer, then stops the reading if no honest explanation is found. Non-numeric contradictions (a named customer that does not exist, a participating preference in the terms that the deck does not state) are blatant by default.

web.rule: A claim is confirmed or contradicted on the web only with at least min_independent_sources sources on distinct domains, after searching both for and against. Otherwise it is unverifiable, which is a valid state, never 'probably false'. Series C keeps the series B scope and adds the annual accounts filed at the company registry (Infogreffe, Companies House, Handelsregister or the local registry) compared with the audited accounts, the history of the public pricing page on the Wayback Machine, the trend of public reviews (G2, Capterra) over 24 months, litigation and security incidents made public, the rounds raised by competitors since the series B, and listed comparables for the benchmarks. An ARR is never checked on the internet.

revenue.proof: monthly P&L by product and geography (48 months), audited accounts (three fiscal years)

customers.proof: top 20 contracts, monthly P&L by customer

retention.proof: cohort table by segment and acquisition year (36 months or more)

nrr.proof: cohort table by segment and acquisition year: net revenue retention over 12 months, per vintage

churn.proof: cohort table, CRM win/loss with the reason per lost customer

acquisition.proof: CRM export with channel, segment, product and geography per deal, sales and marketing spend in the P&L

pipeline.proof: CRM export with stage, probability, amount and segment per deal; financial model for the plan

sales_cycle.proof: CRM export with first contact and signature dates

founder_sales.proof: CRM export with the owner of each signed deal, sales roster for the start dates

gross_margin.proof: audited accounts and monthly P&L by product: revenue and cost of revenue

concentration.proof: top 20 contracts, P&L by customer over 24 months

burn_multiple.proof: monthly P&L: net burn and net new ARR, three twelve-month windows

rule_of_40.proof: monthly P&L and audited accounts: revenue growth and free cash flow or operating margin, for each of the last two fiscal years

magic_number.proof: monthly P&L: net new ARR of the quarter and sales and marketing spend of the previous quarter

quota_attainment.proof: sales roster: quota and attainment by rep and by quarter

rep_ramp.proof: sales roster: start date and months to full quota per rep

second_engine.proof: P&L by product and geography, CRM export: ARR, start date and economics of the segment, geography, product or channel opened after the first

breakeven.proof: audited accounts for a breakeven reached; three-year financial model for the month where net burn turns positive and the cumulative cash to get there

audited_figure.proof: audited annual accounts: the figure the deck attributes to them

win_rate.proof: CRM win/loss: deals won and lost against each named competitor, by quarter over 24 months

attrition.proof: org chart and headcount history: departures by function and whether regretted

board.proof: board decks or minutes: members, affiliations, independent seats, meeting dates

pricing.proof: top 20 contracts and billing export showing the price paid

cap_table.proof: cap table with the terms of every round

plan_vs_actual.proof: board decks or minutes for the plan or budget of each quarter, monthly P&L for the actual: ARR, net new ARR, net burn, headcount

net_price.proof: billing export: list price and net price per contract, month by month; the public pricing page and its history on the Wayback Machine for the list price

discount_rate.proof: billing export: discount per contract, month by month over 24 months

fcf_margin.proof: monthly P&L and the cash flow statements of the audited accounts: free cash flow over revenue, over 24 months

zero_burn_growth.proof: three-year financial model: the zero-burn scenario, spending frozen at the level the cash on hand allows, and the growth it forecasts

product_share.proof: monthly P&L by product: ARR, new ARR and gross margin of each product after the first

geo_share.proof: monthly P&L by geography: ARR, new ARR and gross margin outside the home country

liquidation_preference.proof: cap table with the terms of every round: preference multiple, participation, seniority, ratchets

debt_terms.proof: cap table terms and debt agreements: amount, rate, maturity, covenants, warrants, security; company registry for registered charges, press, litigation made public

audit_opinion.proof: audited accounts: the auditor's opinion for each of the last three fiscal years, unqualified or qualified with the reason; the accounts filed at the company registry

controls_certification.proof: the SOC 2 report or ISO 27001 certificate with its date and scope; the public trust page, the certification body's register, security incidents made public

named_customer.proof: top 20 contracts; customer website, LinkedIn, public review

competitor.proof: competitor websites, public reviews of the category

competitor_funding.proof: press of the rounds raised by competitors since the series B, company registries, investor portfolio pages

exit_comparable.proof: public filings of listed comparables, press of acquisitions in the category with the acquirer named

key_hire.proof: LinkedIn profile of the hire with that role at the company

exec_team.proof: org chart with the executive team; LinkedIn profile of the executive with that role at the company, and for the CFO the audited accounts previously held

exec_departure.proof: org chart with end dates; LinkedIn profile of the executive showing the departure

headcount.proof: org chart and headcount history, P&L by function; LinkedIn headcount and its trend

job_posts.proof: careers page, LinkedIn job posts, by function and by country

reviews.proof: G2, Capterra or the sector's review site, and the trend of ratings and review counts over 24 months

employee_reviews.proof: Glassdoor or the local equivalent: rating, review count, recent reviews for and against

funding.proof: cap table, press of every previous round, registry

secondary_or_debt.proof: cap table with the secondary sale or the debt line and its terms; press

expansion.proof: entities and offices in the financial model, the P&L by geography and the org chart; company registries for announced subsidiaries, job posts by country

market.proof: public data behind the bottom-up figures

plan_vs_actual.rule: The report lays out, by code, every claim of claim_type with a metric and a period: the plan read in the board pack, the actual read in the P&L, and the gap in percent, (actual - plan) / |plan|, computed by code. The last `quarters` periods are shown. Per metric, the average gap and, where missed_if is set, the number of quarters missed (actual below plan for 'below', above plan for 'above'). Empty cells stay empty. Displayed next to D1 and H2, never scored.

question.en: Which segments are served, and do the last twenty customers match them?
question.fr: Quels segments sont servis, et les vingt derniers clients y correspondent-ils ?

questions.found_if: A nameable profile (size, role, sector) per segment, and the last twenty signed contracts fit one of them.
questions.note: A customer that fits no segment is a question for the call.

question.en: Why do they buy, and why do they renew, per segment, in their own words?
question.fr: Pourquoi achètent-ils, et pourquoi renouvellent-ils, par segment, dans leurs mots ?

questions.found_if: A purchase quote and a renewal quote per segment, or a documented use case with both.
questions.note: One segment quoted for all = partial.

question.en: What was dropped since the series B?
question.fr: Qu'est-ce qui a été abandonné depuis la série B ?

questions.found_if: A segment, geography, product or channel abandoned since the series B round, dated, with what triggered it.
questions.note: Nothing dropped since the series B = partial at best.

question.en: ARR today, and the monthly curve over 48 months?
question.fr: ARR aujourd'hui, et la courbe mensuelle sur 48 mois ?

questions.found_if: An ARR and the monthly points over 48 months, matching the P&L and the audited accounts.
questions.note: A growth percentage without its starting point = absent.

question.en: How many paying customers, and the average contract value by segment?
question.fr: Combien de clients payants, et le contrat moyen par segment ?

questions.found_if: A customer count and an ACV per segment, backed by the contracts or the P&L.

question.en: Year-over-year growth for each of the last three years, with the starting points?
question.fr: Croissance sur un an pour chacune des trois dernières années, avec les points de départ ?

questions.found_if: Four dated ARR points twelve months apart and the three ratios.
questions.note: Benchmark shown next to the figure, never in the score.

question.en: Do the named customers exist, pay, and use the product?
question.fr: Les clients nommés existent-ils, paient-ils, et utilisent-ils le produit ?

questions.found_if: Confirmed outside the deck: a contract in the annexes, and a website, LinkedIn page or public review.
questions.note: Still the central question. Cannot be found from the deck alone. Absent = red.

question.en: How much of ARR do the top twenty customers make, and how has that share moved over 24 months?
question.fr: Quelle part de l'ARR font les vingt premiers clients, et comment cette part a-t-elle évolué sur 24 mois ?

questions.found_if: A share of ARR for the top twenty today and 24 months ago, confirmed against the contracts or the P&L.
questions.note: A single customer above 20 % of ARR is a question for the call, not a verdict.

question.en: New ARR by channel, segment, product and geography?
question.fr: Nouvel ARR par canal, segment, produit et géographie ?

questions.found_if: Each channel, segment, product and geography with its share of new ARR over twelve months, from the CRM export and the P&L.
questions.note: All from one channel or one product = partial.

question.en: Gross margin, confirmed against the audited accounts?
question.fr: Marge brute, confirmée contre les comptes audités ?

questions.found_if: A gross margin with what is included in cost of revenue, and the same figure in the audited accounts.
questions.note: A margin that excludes hosting, support or implementation = partial.

question.en: CAC payback by channel and by segment, and its trend over 24 months?
question.fr: Délai de récupération du CAC par canal et par segment, et sa tendance sur 24 mois ?

questions.found_if: A payback in months per channel and per segment, with the method, and its curve over 24 months.
questions.note: A single blended figure = partial.

question.en: Burn multiple over three twelve-month windows?
question.fr: Burn multiple sur trois fenêtres de douze mois ?

questions.found_if: Net burn divided by net new ARR for each of the last three twelve-month windows, from the P&L, and the direction of the change.
questions.note: Growth that slows faster than burn falls is a red signal of the stage. Benchmark shown next to the figure (Sacks), never in the score.

question.en: Rule of 40, two years in a row?
question.fr: Rule of 40, deux années de suite ?

questions.found_if: Revenue growth plus free cash flow or operating margin for each of the last two fiscal years, from the P&L and the audited accounts.
questions.note: One year only = partial. Benchmark shown next to the figure, never in the score.

question.en: Sales efficiency: magic number?
question.fr: Efficacité commerciale : magic number ?

questions.found_if: Net new ARR of the quarter over the previous quarter's sales and marketing spend, over the last four quarters.
questions.note: B2B only. Weight 0 in B2C.

question.en: Free cash flow margin over 24 months, and its direction?
question.fr: Marge de cash-flow libre sur 24 mois, et sa direction ?

questions.found_if: Free cash flow over revenue, quarter by quarter over 24 months, from the P&L and the cash flow statements of the audited accounts.
questions.note: A margin without its direction = partial. Benchmark shown next to the figure, never in the score.

question.en: What growth does the model forecast at zero burn?
question.fr: Quelle croissance le modèle prévoit-il à burn zéro ?

questions.found_if: A scenario of the three-year model where spending is frozen at the level the cash on hand allows, with the ARR growth it forecasts year by year.
questions.note: A model without a zero-burn scenario = absent. The scenario is read, never judged.

question.en: Breakeven: reached, with its date in the accounts, or dated in the model?
question.fr: Point mort : atteint, avec sa date dans les comptes, ou daté dans le modèle ?

questions.found_if: The period where net burn turned positive, in the audited accounts or the P&L, or the month where it does in the three-year model with the cumulative cash to get there.
questions.note: Neither reached nor dated = absent.

question.en: Plan against actual over eight quarters: the average gap, and how many quarters were missed?
question.fr: Plan contre réalisé sur huit trimestres : l'écart moyen, et combien de trimestres manqués ?

questions.found_if: For each of the last eight quarters, the plan of the board pack and the actual of the P&L for ARR, net new ARR, net burn and headcount, the average gap and the number of quarters missed.
questions.note: The central proof of the stage: the series B deck promised figures, the board packs say what happened. A plan missed two years in a row is a red signal of the stage. Absent = red. Laid out quarter by quarter in the report.

question.en: Pricing power: net price against list price per contract, and the trend of discounts over 24 months?
question.fr: Pouvoir de prix : prix net contre prix liste par contrat, et la tendance des remises sur 24 mois ?

questions.found_if: The list price and the net price of each contract, and the average discount month by month over 24 months, from the billing export.
questions.note: Discounts that rise are a red signal of the stage.

question.en: Win rate against each competitor, and its trend over 24 months?
question.fr: Taux de gain contre chaque concurrent, et sa tendance sur 24 mois ?

questions.found_if: Deals won and lost against each named competitor, quarter by quarter over 24 months, from the CRM win/loss.
questions.note: A win rate without its trend = partial.

question.en: What share of ARR do the products after the first make, and with what economics next to the first?
question.fr: Quelle part de l'ARR font les produits après le premier, et avec quelle économie à côté du premier ?

questions.found_if: The ARR of each product after the first as a share of total ARR, with its gross margin and new ARR next to those of the first product, from the P&L by product.
questions.note: A second product without its own economics = partial at best.

question.en: What share of ARR comes from outside the home country, and with what economics?
question.fr: Quelle part de l'ARR vient de l'extérieur du pays d'origine, et avec quelle économie ?

questions.found_if: The ARR outside the home country as a share of total ARR, by country or region, with its gross margin and new ARR, from the P&L by geography.
questions.note: A geography without its own economics = partial at best.

question.en: What share of deals is signed without a founder, and by reps with more than twelve months in the company?
question.fr: Quelle part des ventes est signée sans fondateur, et par des commerciaux de plus de douze mois d'ancienneté ?

questions.found_if: The share of signed deals whose owner in the CRM is not a founder, and the share owned by reps whose start date is more than twelve months old.
questions.note: B2B only. Weight 0 in B2C. Absent = red.

question.en: Net revenue retention by segment and by cohort vintage?
question.fr: Rétention nette du revenu (NRR) par segment et par millésime de cohorte ?

questions.found_if: An NRR per segment and per acquisition year over a twelve-month window, with the definition used, recomputable from the cohorts.
questions.note: Older cohorts below younger ones are a red signal of the stage and a question for the call. Benchmark shown next to the figure, never in the score.

question.en: Gross retention and logo churn, with the reasons?
question.fr: Rétention brute et churn logo, avec les raisons ?

questions.found_if: A gross revenue retention and a logo churn figure, and a reason per lost customer.
questions.note: Absent = the deck hides churn. Red.

question.en: Do the cohorts flatten at 36 months, in each segment?
question.fr: Les cohortes s'aplatissent-elles à 36 mois, dans chaque segment ?

questions.found_if: Cohort curves of at least 36 months per segment, with the month where they flatten.
questions.note: A segment whose cohorts do not flatten is a question for the call.

question.en: Expansion: what share of new ARR comes from existing customers, and what triggers it?
question.fr: Expansion : quelle part du nouvel ARR vient des clients existants, et qu'est-ce qui la déclenche ?

questions.found_if: A share of net new ARR from expansion, with the trigger (seats, modules, price, second product).

question.en: Market size computed bottom-up with the ACV by segment, and the share already taken?
question.fr: Taille du marché par le bas avec l'ACV par segment, et la part déjà prise ?

questions.found_if: Possible customers per segment multiplied by the ACV signed in that segment, with visible assumptions, and the current ARR as a share of it.
questions.note: An analyst figure = absent.

question.en: Who are the competitors, and what is the win rate against each?
question.fr: Qui sont les concurrents, et quel est le taux de gain contre chacun ?

questions.found_if: Named competitors, the same names in the CRM win/loss with a win rate against each.
questions.note: Web check: omitted competitors become a contradiction.

question.en: Which entrants have raised money since the series B?
question.fr: Quels entrants ont levé depuis la série B ?

questions.found_if: The competitors that raised a round since the series B, with the amount and the date, and what the deck says about them.
questions.note: Web check: the press of competitors' rounds. A funded entrant the deck does not name is a contradiction.

question.en: Why now, and why still?
question.fr: Pourquoi maintenant, et pourquoi encore ?

questions.found_if: A recent, named, verifiable change, why the window is still open after the series B, and what a well-funded entrant would need.

question.en: Does the executive team exist, and has the CFO already run audited accounts?
question.fr: Le comité de direction existe-t-il, et le CFO a-t-il déjà tenu des comptes audités ?

questions.found_if: CFO, CRO or VP Sales, CTO or VP Engineering, CPO: each named in the deck and found on LinkedIn with that role at the company, and a CFO who has already held audited accounts, here or before.
questions.note: An executive on a slide who is not on LinkedIn is a contradiction. Absent = red.

question.en: Which executives left in the last 24 months, and why?
question.fr: Quels dirigeants sont partis dans les 24 derniers mois, et pourquoi ?

questions.found_if: Each departure from the executive team with its date and a reason, matching the org chart and LinkedIn.
questions.note: A departure found on LinkedIn and not in the deck is a contradiction.

question.en: Headcount by function over 36 months, and regretted attrition?
question.fr: Effectifs par fonction sur 36 mois, et attrition regrettée ?

questions.found_if: Headcount per function month by month over 36 months, matching the P&L by function, and the share of departures the company did not want.
questions.note: Headcount that does not match the P&L is a gap to probe.

question.en: The board: members, independents, cadence?
question.fr: Le board : membres, indépendants, cadence ?

questions.found_if: The board members with their affiliation, the independent seats, and the meeting dates of the last eight quarters.

question.en: Controls: three fiscal years audited without qualification, and SOC 2 or ISO 27001?
question.fr: Contrôles : trois exercices audités sans réserve, et SOC 2 ou ISO 27001 ?

questions.found_if: An unqualified auditor's opinion on each of the last three fiscal years, and, for a B2B company, a SOC 2 report or an ISO 27001 certificate with its date and scope.
questions.note: Accounts with a qualified opinion are a red signal of the stage. In B2C the certification is not asked: three unqualified opinions = found.

question.en: Do the open job posts match the hiring plan, by function and by country?
question.fr: Les offres d'emploi ouvertes correspondent-elles au plan de recrutement, par fonction et par pays ?

questions.found_if: Public job posts that correspond to the hiring plan of the round, function by function and country by country.
questions.note: A country in the plan with no post: a question for the call.

question.en: Who owns what?
question.fr: Qui possède quoi ?

questions.found_if: Founders, investors, employees, option pool and what is left to grant, from the cap table.

question.en: How much is asked, and what for, by function, product and geography?
question.fr: Combien demandé, à quoi ça sert, par fonction, produit et géographie ?

questions.found_if: An amount and a breakdown by function, by product and by geography.

question.en: Were the goals of the series B reached?
question.fr: Les objectifs de la série B ont-ils été atteints ?

questions.found_if: The goals the series B round set (ARR, NRR, burn multiple, breakeven month), each with what was reached and when, from the board packs and the P&L.
questions.note: The series B deck promised them. Absent = red. Shown next to the plan vs actual table.

question.en: Runway and burn on the three-year model?
question.fr: Runway et burn sur le modèle à trois ans ?

questions.found_if: Monthly burn, cash and months of runway, consistent with the financial model, with and without the round.

question.en: Previous rounds, the stack of liquidation preferences, secondary sales, and debt with its terms?
question.fr: Tours précédents, pile de préférences de liquidation, cessions secondaires, et dette avec ses termes ?

questions.found_if: Amounts and investors for each round, the preference of each (multiple, participation, seniority, ratchets), any secondary sale, and every debt line with its terms, from the cap table and the terms.
questions.note: A participating preference or a ratchet absent from the deck and present in the terms is a contradiction.

question.en: Which exit path, in facts only?
question.fr: Quel chemin de sortie, en faits seulement ?

questions.found_if: Named acquirers with a public trace of interest in the category, or listed comparables with their filings.
questions.note: Facts only, shown as benchmarks. Never a valuation, never a multiple applied to the company.

question.en: Customers we can call, including one that left, one of the second product and one outside the home country?
question.fr: Des clients qu'on peut appeler, dont un qui est parti, un du deuxième produit et un hors du pays d'origine ?

questions.found_if: Names and a way to contact them, including at least one lost customer, one customer of a product after the first, and one outside the home country.

question.en: Executives, board members, and one executive who left, we can call?
question.fr: Des dirigeants, des membres du board, et un dirigeant parti, qu'on peut appeler ?

questions.found_if: Same.
questions.note: Asked to prepare the call, not to judge the deck.
